sections.body: Every shipment leaves with a complete, consistent document set so the buyer clears customs without a single query.
All export shipments from Toamasina — sea, air and courier.

1. Check the L/C or purchase order against the final invoice value.
2. Weigh the loaded truck at the weighbridge — packing-list weights must match within 2%.
3. Print the packing list and commercial invoice from the shipment card (Documents buttons).
4. Attach the transport document for the mode:
   • Sea — Bill of lading from the forwarder (booking no. must match).
   • Air — AWB issued by the carrier (flight no. must match).
   • Courier — courier waybill (tracking no. must match).
5. Collect the Certificate of Origin from the Chamber of Commerce (allow 1 working day).
6. Submit the full set to the bank / buyer within 3 working days of gate-out.
Invoice value differs from L/C • carton count on packing list differs from survey report • missing HS code 6110 on courier proforma • AWB copy not endorsed.
Documents submitted ≤ 3 working days after gate-out. Track misses in the monthly shipping report.
Right-first-time dyeing. Every bulk lot must match the approved lab dip before fabric moves to cutting.
Lab dip (3 options) → buyer or merchandiser approval → bulk lot → QC check → fabric release.

• ΔE ≤ 1.0 vs approved lab dip under D65 light.
• RFT (right-first-time) target ≥ 90% per month.
• Water ≤ 60 L per kg, power ≤ 1.2 kWh per kg, steam ≤ 5 kg per kg — record actuals in the Dye House module.
One re-dye allowed after a failed QC. A second failure escalates to Merchandising + buyer for a shade band review — never re-dye twice without approval.
Batch DB-#### entries must carry the recipe, resources and QC result the same day. Dye KPIs are read from those records.
Catch panel defects at the machine, not at final inspection.

• Tambour / fabric surface visual check.
• Measurement check on a fresh panel every 2 hours against the tech sheet (see Wiki tech sheets).
• Needle-ladder and oil-stain scan under the inspection lamp.
Score defects: 1 pt (< 3 cm), 2 pts (3–6 cm), 4 pts (> 9 cm). Hold the panel when it exceeds 28 points per 100 m².
Any knitter may stop a machine for a repeating defect. Log the downtime event on the Machine Board immediately — unlogged stoppages count against utilization.
All flat knitters (Shenzhou + Puyuan banks), start of every shift.

1. Blow the needle bed with compressed air — lint first, then visual.
2. Check oil level in the carriage and top up to the sight-glass mark.
3. Run a 20-course test swatch; verify stitch length against the tech sheet.
4. Load the pattern file and confirm the pattern hash matches the tech pack version.
5. Set the machine target on the Machine Board (see machine card).
Empty the needle bed, drop the take-down, wipe the carriage rail, leave the machine in 'Idle' on the board.
Deep-clean the yarn feeders every Monday before the shift; record as 'Maintenance' so utilization stays honest.

wiki.title: Bundle scan discipline on the sewing floor

sections.body: The scan module is the factory's truth. If a piece is not scanned, it does not exist.

• Scan every bundle at every operation — never skip a station.
• Never split a bundle; the barcode stands for the full bundle quantity.
• Over-scan is blocked at 100% of bundle quantity (error 400 by design).
• End of day: reconcile scanned vs issued bundles; investigate every gap before the next shift.
Worker efficiency and floor WIP are computed from scans only. Manual counts are not accepted as corrections — fix the scan, not the report.
Buyer approvals earned on time, in the right order, with no wasted couriers.
Proto (7 days) → Fit (5 days) → PP sample — must be approved BEFORE bulk cutting → TOP sample travels with the shipment.
Sampling room photos + measurement sheet within 48 h of sample completion; merchandiser review same day.
Book sample couriers through Shipping (packing instruction WIKI-114). Never put samples in personal luggage.
Log every submission and approval in the Sampling module — the buyer-facing status must always be current.

wiki.title: Yarn incoming inspection & shade band retention

sections.body: Every yarn lot entering the store, before it is booked into inventory.

• Sample 10% of cones per lot — count, lot number and cone condition.
• Twist and count verification on the wrap wheel vs the PO spec.
• Store humidity 60% ±5%; keep lot bands on the shade rack.
Keep shade bands and lot labels for 2 years — they are the evidence in any buyer shade claim.
Any mismatch → hold the requisition, photograph the cones, raise the supplier claim within 7 days. Never issue suspect yarn to knitting.

wiki.title: Packing instruction — air freight rush (AWB shipments)

sections.body: Buyer launch deadlines, missed vessel cut-offs, or TOP samples with a hard review date. Freight cost is ~6–8× sea — merchandiser approval is mandatory before booking.
5-ply light carton, max 15 kg gross, 10 pcs of cardigans per carton typical. Chargeable weight = max(actual, volume × 167 kg/m³) — report dims to the forwarder.
'AIR CARGO' labels on two sides + AWB pouch on piece 1 of the AWB. No strapping — airports reject strapped cartons at screening.
Commercial invoice 3 copies + packing list inside the pouch; AWB number must match the shipment card exactly.
SH-4504 — 22 cartons / 360 kg on ET852 TNR→CDG, AWB 071-88234761: rush 1,200 pcs of WIKI-108 for BlueOcean's Paris launch.

carton: AIR CARGO ×2 + AWB pouch on piece 1

wiki.title: Packing instruction — courier samples & documents (DHL)

sections.body: TOP / fit samples + full shipping doc set (invoice, packing list, COO copy). One package per destination — never mix buyers.
Mark samples 'SAMPLE — NOT FOR SALE' on the sleeve mark; unstamped samples get customs-valued at retail and the buyer pays duty twice.
HS code 6110 · incoterm DAP · declared value = cost only. Receiver phone number is mandatory or DHL holds the piece.
TNR pickup 15:00 — book before 13:00. Post the tracking number in the activity thread the moment the label prints.
SH-4505 — ORD-1001 TOP samples + documents, DHL tracking JD014600003812345678, TNR → London LHR.

sections.body: 20 pcs per carton = 2 S + 8 M + 8 L + 2 XL. Scale to 10-pc cartons as 1 S + 4 M + 4 L + 1 XL.

Buyer-portal barcode on every polybag + carton-content label showing the size breakdown (2-8-8-2) on the side mark.
CC the size grid photo to merchandising for the first 5 cartons of every new PO.
